items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: carried it down to Robbins(?). And within a year's time, I went in and asked him

ctx.x: Well, they wanted the melody to this thing. See, first of all, I wouldn't do it because I knew what was going to happen. So Spud kept on asking me about this new chord, you know, to just help me (?) the thing out. So I wrote out the melody and the chords and everything, and carried it down to Robbins(?). And within a year's time, I went in and asked him, "What about...? You didn't send no contract." "For what?" I said, "For 'Swing Is Here'." "That's Benny Goodman's tune. You ain't got nothin' to do with that…
